Position: SAP ABAP Developer 
Location: Morristown, NJ
Duration: 3 Months Contract (Open to Extensions)

Description:

•    We are looking for a SAP ABAP Developer for our direct client in Morristown, NJ for a 6-month contract with full-time potential. 
•    The position requires someone to specify and document critical SAP system changes, primarily in the implemented SD and PS processes.  
•    They will need to interact with users at different levels of the organization to develop business requirements and translate these system specification documentations.  
•    They must be able to make some programming and/or data changes in SAP, and will need to test all system changes. 
•    Need PS configuration experience.

Requirements:

•    SAP experience, with focus in PS and/or SD
•    Excellent communication skills, oral and written 
•    Systems analysis and/or specification development experience 
•    ABAP programming Required
